name: presence
title: Presence
description: Another person's pointer, caret or selection, in the color that names them.
use: Shared work where others are here at the same time: a canvas, a board, a document edited together. Draw each collaborator's pointer where the application says it is, with their name, and their caret and selection in text. Give each person one of the eight identities for the session, presence-1 to presence-8, and keep their name beside it. The pointers are decoration: hide them from assistive technology and say who is here in words elsewhere, such as a pile of avatars.

instead.when: It says who is here or who took part, not where they are
It marks the place where text is still being written by the application
It highlights words for the reader, such as a search match

classes.name: presence
classes.description: A pointer: an arrow whose tip stands at --presence-x and --presence-y in the positioned element that holds it, in the person's identity color. It glides to each new point and takes no pointer event

classes.name: presence-name
classes.description: The person's name, in a flag of their color with the identity ink: beside the arrow's tip, standing on a caret, or on its own in a list of who is here

classes.name: presence-message
classes.description: A short message the person is writing, in a bubble of their color under the name

classes.name: presence-caret
classes.description: Another person's caret in text: an inline bar as tall as the line, in their identity color, that takes no room. A presence-name inside it stands on top of it

classes.name: presence-selection
classes.description: Another person's selection: a tint of their identity color behind the words it holds, carried across lines

classes.name: presence-1
classes.description: Identity 1, --color-identity-1: red in hue. Without a modifier or --presence-color, a presence takes this one

properties.name: --presence-color
properties.description: The person's color. A presence-1 to presence-8 modifier sets it to an identity; set it for a color of the product's own. Read by a presence, a presence-caret, a presence-selection and a presence-name

properties.name: --presence-x
properties.description: Where the arrow's tip stands, from the left edge of the positioned element that holds it. The application sets it

properties.name: --presence-y
properties.description: Where the arrow's tip stands, from the top edge of that element. The application sets it

properties.name: --presence-arrow
properties.description: The size of the arrow; the name stands beside its point
